propositions: AGENTS.md and docs/user-guide.md incorrectly claim transition/claim --force is CLI-only and not exposed over MCP, contradicting the shipped code and the 2026-08-18 operator ruling.
The ruling rescinded the CLI-only policy and now allows --force on all surfaces (library, CLI, MCP), with auditability enforced via absence of signed attestation rather than capability withholding.
The MCP parity sibling already updated _mcp_writes.py docstrings and exposed reason-bearing force on transition_ticket and claim_ticket, but canonical prose documentation was not updated.
Documentation must be rewritten to state force is available on all surfaces, audit comes from absent signed attestation, and CI certificate-checks are the enforcement lever.
